name: Aam Digital
description: Easy-to-use case management software for the social sector that improves the effectiveness and transparency of work with beneficiaries. The offline-first web app is tailored to be used by NGOs anywhere in the world.

name: Aid Management Platform
description: AMP helps governments and development partners gather, access, and monitor information on development activities, with the goal of increasing aid effectiveness.

name: Altinn
description:
Altinn is a platform for digital dialogue between businesses, private individuals and public agencies.
Altinn is also a platform that government bodies can use to develop and host digital services.

name: Apache Fineract
description: Fineract provides a reliable, robust, and affordable solution for entrepreneurs, financial institutions, and service providers to offer financial services to the world’s 3 billion underbanked and unbanked.

name: CKAN
description: CKAN is an Open Source Data Management System to build Data Portals. Trusted by hundreds of portals across the world and supported by an active community, it focuses on extensibility and integration with other tools.

name: Consul Democracy
description: Consul Democracy is a complete citizen participation tool for an open, transparent, and democratic government. This tool is free, secure, open-source, and easy to use, reflecting public values at its core so that all governments can take the first steps toward digital citizen participation.

name: Data Norge
description: Data.norge.no provides a comprehensive overview of datasets, concepts, APIs, information models, services, and events in the public sector, including protected data. It helps you discover, assess, and make use of data.

name: Designsystemet
description: Designsystemet is a publicly maintained open-source design system, owned and coordinated by the Norwegian Digitalisation Agency. It helps create accessible, user-friendly digital services across the public and private sectors.

name: DKAN
description: DKAN is a powerful, community-driven open data platform. As a Drupal module, DKAN leverages Drupal's robust features to create modern, standards-focused, and API-first open data catalogs for a variety of specific use cases.

name: Eurosky Identity Platform
description: Sovereign, EU-hosted identity and data hosting for the AT Protocol: a Personal Data Server that holds each user's account and data, plus Portal, the account-creation and management interface. One account works across hundreds of apps and can move to any provider.

name: Feluda
description: Feluda is a configurable engine for analysing multi-lingual and multi-modal content. While flexible, it is built it to analyse data collected from social media - images,text and video. It is configurable to allow for different use cases such as finding trends and narratives in social media across languages, and surfacing fact checked content corresponding to image and video.

name: FireForm
description: FireForm is an open-source tool that saves first responders hours of administrative overhead. By using local AI to extract data from a single voice memo, it automatically populates required incident forms—ensuring total data privacy and zero redundant paperwork.

name: FormSG
description: FormSG is a form builder tool that enables public officers to instantly create customisable forms with zero code or cost, to safely collect classified and sensitive data.

name: GeoPrism Registry
description: GeoPrism Registry allows for the simultaneous hosting, management, regular update, and sharing of master lists, associated hierarchies, and geospatial data for the geographic objects core to sustainable development including public health, education, agriculture, infrastructure, and other public and private services.

name: Ghost
description: A free, modern, open platform for independent publishing and journalism.

name: GLOBALEAKS
description: GlobaLeaks is a free and open-source whistleblowing software enabling anyone to easily set up and maintain a secure reporting platform.

name: Grievance Redress  System (GRS)
description: Grievance Redress System (GRS) is recognized worldwide as one of the enabling factors for organizations to be efficient, effective, and people-oriented. A functional platform for receiving people’s complaints or grievances facilitates administrators to improve their service delivery systems, thereby improving governance in general.

name: Isomer
description: Isomer is a website builder that allows government agencies to launch static websites easily and for free. It aims to empower the government to easily and effectively communicate with citizens while enabling citizens to easily find the information they are looking for.

name: iVerify
description: AI-powered information platform to combat misinformation and hate speech.

name: Joomla CMS
description: Joomla is a free, open‑source content management system (CMS) for building and running websites and web applications. It includes robust access control, content workflows, multilingual support, an extensible API, and built‑in privacy and security tooling.

name: Kindly
description: Kindly is – an open-source API that detects abusive and cyberbullying intent in messages and provides instant feedback for users to reconsider their message.

name: KoboToolbox
description: KoboToolbox is an open source platform for the collection, management, and visualization of data. As the most widely used primary data collection tool in the nonprofit sector, it is the tool of choice for over 32,000 social impact organizations worldwide.

name: Mastodon
description: Mastodon is a free and open-source software platform for decentralized social networking.

name: Mifos Payment Hub-EE (PH-EE)
description: Modern orchestation engine for digital & real-time Payments enabling DFSPs to connect to and participate in instant inclusive payment systems and for governments to disburse payments in bulk to functional wallet accounts.

name: Mojaloop
description: Open source software for creating payment platforms that will help unbanked people access digital financial services.

name: MOSIP
description: The Modular Open Source Identity Platform (MOSIP) helps Governments and other user organizations implement a digital, foundational identity system in a cost effective way.

name: ODK
description: ODK lets you build powerful forms to collect the data you need wherever it is. Join the leading researchers, field teams, and other professionals using ODK to collect data that matters.

name: Open Contracting Portal
description: The Open Contracting Portal (OC Portal) is an open-source platform built to organize and archive procurement documents, improve data transparency and feedback by the public, and help publish procurement information in the Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS)

name: Open Data Editor
description: Open Data Editor (ODE) is a free, open-source desktop app designed to help nonprofits, data journalists, activists, and public servants detect errors in their datasets. It is designed for people working with tabular data (Excel, Google Sheets, CSV) who don't know how to code.

name: Open Terms Archive
description: Open Terms Archive publicly records every version of the terms of digital services to enable democratic oversight.

name: Open-Pryv.io
description:
Personal Data & Privacy Management Software
A ready-to-use solution for personal data and consent management.
Pryv.io is a solid foundation on which you build your own digital health solution, so you can collect, store, share and rightfully use personal data.

name: OpenCHS
description: OpenCHS is an open-source, multilingual helpline & case management platform that supports governments and NGOs to deliver 24/7 protection, counseling, and referral services, with AI-powered insights for child protection and social services.

name: OpenCRVS
description: OpenCRVS is a user-friendly, open-source platform designed to make civil registration accessible and effective for everyone. It supports the complete process of registering vital events, such as births and deaths, while ensuring offline functionality for remote areas, robust data security, and adherence to global CRVS standards. Tailored for low- and middle-income countries, OpenCRVS is user-centric, inclusive, and enables governments to provide legal identity for all, improve access to essential services, and generate vital statistics for policy-making.

name: OpenFisca
description: OpenFisca is a Rules as Code engine: it enables collaboratively making laws and regulations computable over APIs for developers, datascientists and researchers. This allows building software to help citizens and businesses understand how laws apply to them, designing better rules and public policies, debating potential reforms, and scaling economic micro-simulation.

name: OpenG2P
description: OpenG2P is an open-source platform that enables governments and humanitarian organizations to deliver critical social benefits directly to those who need them. It facilitates the building of secure, inclusive registries and digital cash transfer systems for social protection.

name: PeerTube
description: PeerTube is a tool for hosting, managing, and sharing videos or live streams.

name: Pol.is
description: Polis is a real-time system for gathering, analyzing, and understanding what large groups of people think in their own words, enabled by advanced statistics and machine learning. Polis has been used all over the world by governments, academics, independent media, and citizens.

name: Primero
description: A web app for confidential case management and incident monitoring in social welfare, child protection, and gender-based violence.

name: QField
description: Survey and digitize data in the field with seamless synchronization QField focuses on efficiently getting GIS fieldwork done and exchanging data between the field and the office in a comfortable and user-friendly way.

name: QuarkID
description: QuarkID is the digital trust framework developed by the Government of the City of Buenos Aires that creates a new digital identity system and gives people control over their information, with a security anchor through blockchain.

name: Querido Diário
description: Querido Diário is an open-source toolkit that enables the analysis, manipulation, and centralization of official data extracted from journals published by cities. It also makes this data accessible to everyone in a single platform through a standardized visual interface and a public API.

name: RapidPro
description: Open Source platform that allows anyone to build interactive messaging systems using an easy visual interface

name: SimpleAudit
description: Lightweight AI safety auditing framework for red-teaming AI systems through adversarial probing. Supports multilingual testing across safety, healthcare, and RAG scenarios. Works with cloud APIs or fully local models.

name: Sunbird RC
description: “Sunbird Registry and Credential” or simply “Sunbird RC” is an open source software to rapidly build and deploy next generation electronic registries and verifiable credentials including attestation and verification flows.

name: Tazama
description: Open Source Real-Time Transaction Monitoring Software for Fraud and Money Laundering Detection. Tazama provides anti-fraud capabilities to Mojaloop, MIFOS, and other payment systems.

name: The Ushahidi Platform
description: The Ushahidi Platform is an integrated data crowdsourcing and mapping tool that allows people to rapidly collect, manage and analyze crowdsourced information from their communities. Empowering communities to thrive as a result of accessible data and technology.

name: Tor Browser
description: Tor advances human rights and protects users' privacy on the internet by hiding the connection between their internet address and the services they use.

name: Uli
description: Uli is a browser plugin that provides tools for relief collective response to online gendered abuse. It is backed by open datasets of slurs and an ML model for redaction of gendered abuse in Indian languages.

name: UPYOG
description: The Urban Platform for DeliverY of Online Governance (UPYOG) is a set of Open APIs, services, and reference implementations, setup as a public good, to allow government entities, businesses, startups, and civil society to use a unique digital Infrastructure and build solutions at a large scale. Developed under the National Urban Digital Mission, MoHUA to facilitate the digital delivery of G2G, G2C, G2B services focussing on citizen centricity, UPYOG is available with customizable 14 reference modules.

name: Uwazi
description: Uwazi is an open-source web-based database application designed for human rights defenders to manage collections of information, including documents, evidence, cases and complaints.

name: WSO2 Identity Server
description: WSO2 Identity Server is an open-source Identity and Access Management (IAM) solution supporting secure authentication, identity federation, and user management via open standards such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM 2.0, and FIDO2.

name: X-Road®
description: X-Road® is open-source software that provides unified and secure data exchange between organisations in a collaborative ecosystem.
